title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 have an authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module. Authenticated users with an Accounts role can access metadata of Payment Entries they should not have permission to see due to insufficient permission checks on an endpoint. This vulnerability allows exposure of restricted Payment Entry metadata without proper read permission validation.
